caption: The drawing depicts a chest or trunk shown from multiple perspectives and with details. In the top left portion, there is a top view of the chest lid, rendered in gradients of beige, brown, and dark gray, including a faint rectangular central panel with an outlined decorative feature. The middle of the drawing contains a front elevation of the chest, painted primarily with muted green and blue tones, featuring three main arched panels. Each of these panels contains floral motifs in red, green, and beige, with two symmetrical designs on the sides and a central design that includes the text "ANNA MARIA LESCHORN." The sides of the chest, with simple marbled coloration in dark green and blue, are shown in elevation at the right. Two vertical fluted columns separate the three front panels. At the upper right, there are detailed, scaled drawings of a key and a lock mechanism, both colored in gray. Handwritten notes indicate the scale of the drawing ("Three Inches Equals One Foot") and are visible in the upper right section. The bottom right corner includes a barely visible label or signature, reading "FRANZ LECHER." The chest stands on short, blocky feet and has a flat top and molded edge.
title: Chest
